scenes.say: Can everyone read your site and move around easily? How do color and motion affect accessibility?

scenes.label: Contrast
scenes.sub: WCAG AA needs 4.5 to 1 ratio for text.
scenes.say: Color contrast is crucial. Web Content Accessibility Guidelines AA requires at least a four point five to one ratio between text and background.
Some users get dizzy with motion. Use the prefers reduced motion media query in CSS to turn off animations if a user requests it.
Here's your checklist: Check color contrast with tools, respect reduced motion settings, and always test manually because tools can't catch everything.

scenes.question: Is AAA color contrast always required?
scenes.right: No, AA is practical and required. AAA is stricter and often not achievable.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Do you always need to hit triple A color contrast? No. Double A is the standard—triple A is much stricter and not always possible.
